buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Terms and conditions for bidders 1- PAN NO. AND GST Registration must submit with the technical bid. 2- Firm Registration certificate in Madhya Pradesh govt. (Gumasta) 3- Past work of similar product supply at government sector. 4- OEM authorization letter for particular tender reference must submit with the technical bid. 5- The sample of the material must be deposited in the Municipal Council for verification before submitting the tender. The tender of bidders who fail to submit the sample will not be considered. 6- Average annual Turn over of bidder of rs 50 lakh in last three years. Turn over certificate, income tax re turn and balance sheet certified by CA with udin number must submit with the technical bid. 7- MSME, ISO 9001 8- The Bidder should submit last 1 year GST return copy 9- Non blacklisted declaration on rs 200/- notarized stamp paper. . 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 4. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support.
